Coconut Island bridge collapsed after warning; Hawaii faces $22 million fix
Meryl Streep’s former 1954 Hollywood Hills home sold for $4.8 million
Anti-CEC protest: Congress chief Kharge dons Batman mask during march to Supreme Court
stories.summary: Opposition stalwarts, along with hundreds of supporters and activists, undertook their "March for Democracy" to the Supreme Court on Monday on a heavily barricaded route and filed a joint petition against SIR and alleged poll irregularities, in another show of strength after a series of street protests over the "vote chori" charge.

stories.title: Same cause, separate protests: Why Congress and CJP are keeping their distance
South Africa, India share common vision for medicinal plant conservation: Minister
stories.summary: India and South Africa are joining forces to protect medicinal plants and ensure future biodiversity. Experts are increasingly worried about the soaring demand for these plants and the environmental challenges jeopardizing their existence. Moreover, unsustainable harvesting practices contribute to the depletion of these crucial resources. By deepening cooperation in traditional medicine, both nations aim to support public health, preserving critical knowledge and cultivation methods of medicinal species.

stories.title: Kansas couple sought $550,000 over wedding venue sprinkler rules; appeals court revives one claim
stories.summary: A Kansas couple who planned to build a wedding venue sought more than $550,000 in damages after a two-year construction delay and changes to local building rules led to a dispute over sprinkler requirements. The Kansas Court of Appeals has now revived their equal protection claim against Leavenworth County while upholding the dismissal of their other claims.

stories.title: Ted Turner’s Cartoon-Inspired Foundation Backs Young Conservationists in 11 Countries
Suspected IED explodes in J&K's Poonch, several feared dead; security heightened
stories.summary: An explosion was reported in the Satwal-Naki area near the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir. Security measures were heightened as officials assessed the situation following the blast. It remains unclear whether the individuals involved were terrorists or Pakistani security personnel. Indian Army troops detected and destroyed two rusted landmines during ongoing operations in the Mendhar sector.

stories.title: ‘Dear Surya Kant ... ’: Congress Keralam unit’s post asking CJI to 'resign' draws BJP fire
Kris Krohn lists Utah estate with a disappearing pool
stories.summary: Kris Krohn has listed his expansive mansion in Utah for $13.95 million. This sprawling estate features a unique hydraulic indoor pool that transforms into a ballroom. The property also includes a commercial-grade gym, spa facilities, and an extensive garage for car collections. The mansion is designed for full-time living and hosting large events. It is expected to attract entrepreneurs and high-level professionals looking for a versatile space.

stories.title: In 1967, Martin Luther King Jr. preached at Shiloh Baptist Church; now it has a $750,000 grant
stories.summary: Shiloh Baptist Church in Cleveland has secured a $750,000 grant to enhance its historic building. The funding aims to improve accessibility and support ongoing community services. Planned repairs include restoring the portico and addressing water damage throughout the church. This grant connects the church's rich history in civil rights activism to its future role in the community. The church aims to remain a vibrant space for worship and community engagement.

stories.title: US agents raid lawmaker Ilhan Omar's home as part of immigration fraud probe
UK universities withdraw admission offers to Indian, Pakistani, Nigerian students as visa refusals rise
Saudi to increase crude exports to 10million bpd, examine transport alternatives
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia intends to enhance its crude oil export capacity through pipeline modifications and upgrades. Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman announced potential increases by repurposing a gas pipeline for oil transport. The initial increase could reach 1.2 million barrels per day within weeks. Upgrades to the East-West pipeline could eventually allow exports to reach 10 million barrels per day over the next few years.

stories.title: Amelia Earhart mystery: Team heads to remote Pacific island to investigate possible plane wreckage
stories.summary: A group of adept marine archaeologists is gearing up for an intriguing exploration in the lagoon at Nikumaroro Island. This five-day expedition aims to uncover whether a mysterious object discovered there is linked to Amelia Earhart's vanished aircraft. With an array of modern equipment at their disposal, they hope to shed light on decades of speculation surrounding her disappearance and the island's enigmatic connection to her fate.

Steelmaker to steer Rs 440cr revamp of 9 government ITIs

stories.title: 'Gods would be aghast': SC seeks balance between faith and public health in firecracker debate
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has reiterated the urgent need to tackle the health hazards posed by firecrackers. It underscored the vital role of community awareness in promoting environmentally friendly practices during festive celebrations. In its deliberations, the court questioned the religious relevance of firecracker usage, especially when weighed against the potential health risks.

stories.title: ‘My hero is Smit Machchhar’: Shiv Sena (UBT) spokesperson Anand Dubey quits over party’s ‘silence’
FIR against Kejriwal, AAP leaders for 'chaos' at Bangla Sahib during CEC protest
stories.summary: DSGMC president Harmeet Singh Kalka, after filing the complaint, had said there was "great resentment within the Sikh community" over the alleged attempt by AAP workers to stage a protest near Gurudwara Bangla Sahib. He said the committee had taken action against those involved and lodged a police complaint against AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal.

stories.title: Frank Lloyd Wright’s only planetarium reopens after a two-decade restoration
Danielle Steel quietly funded San Francisco homeless outreach for 11 years, helping 300 people at a time
stories.summary: For over a decade, Danielle Steel spearheaded a homeless outreach initiative in San Francisco under her foundation, Yo! Angel. This program diligently provided vital supplies, including clothing, hygiene products, and food, to around 300 individuals every three weeks. Regrettably, the outreach has come to a halt due to soaring operational expenses and insufficient fundraising efforts.

stories.title: Emma Watson-backed helpline offers free legal advice to women facing sexual harassment at work
stories.summary: In 2019, Emma Watson helped fund a free legal advice line for women facing sexual harassment at work in England and Wales. Launched by Rights of Women, the service continues to operate seven years later, offering specialist guidance on reporting harassment, filing complaints, understanding legal rights and taking action against employers.

stories.title: Russia offers one-day ceasefire if Kyiv holds elections, rejects 60-day truce bid
stories.summary: Russia announced a one-day ceasefire to allow presidential elections in Ukraine, rejecting a longer truce proposed by Zelenskyy. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov emphasised the need for an overall peace deal instead of a temporary ceasefire. Zelenskyy suggested a 60-day ceasefire in response to criticism from Donald Trump regarding his leadership. He insisted that the decision about Ukraine's leadership belongs to its people and not external actors.

Democrats aim to elect 100 women to House as party eyes control of Congress in US midterms
Zelenskyy says Russia strikes Ukraine energy sites despite Trump’s ceasefire claim
How an Ethiopian coffee farmer inspired Hugh Jackman to build a business supporting farming families
stories.summary: Hugh Jackman embarked on an inspiring journey by launching Laughing Man Coffee after encountering a coffee farmer in Ethiopia. This initiative is dedicated to uplifting farming communities through various essential programs, including healthcare, safe housing, scholarships, and business training. The Laughing Man Foundation stems from Jackman's passion for aiding coffee-farming families in enhancing their livelihoods, partnering with others to broaden global support to these communities.

stories.title: Kim Kardashian’s 1.5-acre Hidden Hills ranch also had a four-stall stable
Tyeb Mehta’s ‘Rickshaw Puller’ fetches record Rs 69.1 crore at Volte Una auction
stories.summary: Tyeb Mehta's painting Rickshaw Puller set a world auction record by selling for Rs 69.1 crore. This transaction eclipsed the previous record, demonstrating the growing market for Indian art. Volte Una, the auction house conducting the sale, focuses on selling one major work at a time. Mehta achieved significant recognition later in his career.

'They are inconveniencing common public': Yogi Adityanath slams INDIA bloc for 'blaming EC when they lose'
No more a free circus, but a tamasha worth crores
stories.summary: Congress and left-wing organizations are currently staging protests in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Despite a Supreme Court dismissal of their petition for his removal, Rahul Gandhi continues to lead these protests. Gandhi's actions have been criticized as immature and lacking political understanding during these demonstrations. His tactics appear to be aimed at gaining publicity, which has affected his public standing negatively.

stories.title: Michigan couple loses claim to 50-foot land strip after neighbour commissions two surveys
stories.summary: A Michigan couple has lost a legal battle over a 50-foot-wide strip of land they claimed was wrongly excluded from their property because of an error in a 1965 deed. The couple, who bought their land at a 2015 tax sale, argued that previous owners had used the disputed area for decades. However, two surveys placed the land within their neighbour's property. On October 9, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals ruled against the couple, citing insufficient evidence to establish ownership.

stories.title: Tyler Perry donated $750K to clear property tax debt for 300+ Atlanta seniors
stories.summary: Tyler Perry has made a significant donation of $750,000 to assist low-income senior citizens in Atlanta. This contribution will help more than 300 seniors pay overdue property taxes and remain in their homes. Additionally, it will support a pilot program for another 100 seniors facing property tax increases. Mayor Dickens emphasized the importance of preserving the homes of longstanding residents amid Atlanta's growth.

stories.title: INDIA bloc fumes as CJI declines meeting request; Raut says ‘people will remember this’
University of Glasgow develops £20 ultrasound device to produce fertiliser from air and water
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Glasgow have developed an affordable ultrasound device to produce nitrate for agriculture. This device uses sound waves, air, and water to create nitrate without industrial production reliance. While current experiments show potential, energy consumption remains high compared to the Haber-Bosch process. The team plans to refine the design over the next year for practical agricultural use.

Beyoncé expands beauty scholarships to the UK with $250,000 for 10 schools
Melinda French Gates and daughters back $70 million fund for women's health
In 2005, this Australian home sold for A$420,000; 20 years later, it fetched A$1.375 million
stories.summary: Wonga Park in Australia has witnessed remarkable appreciation in property value, rising from A$420,000 in 2005 to A$1.375 million by 2025. This enchanting home boasts a 160-metre miniature railway, picturesque gardens, a chicken coop, and stunning vistas of the Dandenong Ranges. Its allure is further enhanced by five bedrooms and unique features, ensuring it remains a sought-after gem among buyers over the years.

stories.title: Tribunal Orders Claim Reassessment: Qld body told to revisit defect case; payout cap may leave $200k gap
stories.summary: A homeowner in Brisbane encountered severe hurdles when dealing with a building plagued by significant structural flaws. The Queensland Building and Construction Commission initially denied his claim, but a tribunal later overturned this ruling. With nine major defects needing repairs estimated at over $500,000, any compensation may still fall short due to statutory limits. The QBCC is now reviewing his claim for possible reimbursement.

stories.title: ‘This govt will go’: Shashi Tharoor ahead of Congress march to Supreme Court
India’s agri-seed sector accounts for the largest share of receipts under benefit sharing regulations during April-Sept
1861 Texas home ranks third among America's haunted spots; visitors report woman in white
UK engineers build tiny pump that could let robots move without bulky motors
Buckingham Palace workers find theatre listings, newspaper pages, and a sixpence ticket
stories.summary: During the refurbishment of Buckingham Palace, various historical objects were discovered hidden under the floorboards. These items included hobnailed boots, betting slips, and newspaper fragments dating back to the 19th century. Additionally, a typed document concerning Queen Elizabeth II's diplomatic reception from 1977 was recovered. The restoration aims to update the palace's electrical systems and lead pipes, some of which are over sixty years old.

stories.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles towards S Korea, Seoul urges Pyongyang to stop ‘UN violations’
Jennifer Garner’s Oklahoma farm inspires her organic baby food business
stories.summary: Jennifer Garner’s work with organic children’s food company Once Upon a Farm has a personal connection to her family’s Oklahoma farm, which has been in the family since 1936. Since joining the business in 2017, Garner has helped promote nutritious food for children. As the company expands across the United States, her family’s farming heritage continues to shape its approach to childhood nutrition and food education.

Saudi Arabia: Fresh Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills 1; Dammam also targeted
Ray Denies Allegations On Stream: Streamer rejects Reggie's claims on sexuality; online dispute continues
stories.summary: Clover Boys streamer Ray has responded to allegations raised in Reggie's third exposé video during a livestream. He denied claims about his personal life, joked about the controversy and suggested the group would temporarily tone down certain jokes until January. Ray also addressed criticism about being greedy and a bad friend, admitting he was unsure whether he had overcome the latter accusation. His comments have circulated online as the dispute continues to unfold.

Thousands of rare grasshoppers released in Norfolk after 86 years
stories.summary: After a long absence, the large marsh grasshopper has been reintroduced to Norfolk's Broads region. The successful conservation effort involved raising grasshoppers and releasing them into restored wetland areas. Following 86 years of population decline, the grasshoppers have hatched for the first time since 1939. The project received significant funding and support from various conservation partners and volunteers.

stories.title: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively’s $500,000 gift helps train Indigenous water operators in Canada
stories.summary: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively's generous contribution to Water First has empowered Indigenous communities by enhancing their water management capabilities. After an intensive 15-month certification process, eight Indigenous trainees have successfully graduated, accumulating over 2,000 hours of combined practical and technical training. These graduates are set to embark on careers in water treatment, fostering self-sufficiency within their communities and showcasing a steadfast dedication to sustainable water management.

stories.title: Tree Removal Sparks Legal Fight: NPS cuts 169 trees at East Potomac; lawsuit targets Trump-era plan
stories.summary: The National Park Service has proposed the removal of 529 trees at East Potomac Golf Links as part of their maintenance strategy, sparking legal disputes. Park proponents are worried about how this redevelopment might affect local recreation. Concerns also revolve around preserving the historic landscape and transparency about future developments. Despite these discussions, the golf course remains operational while plans evolve.

stories.title: Rutherford House Relisted: Beverly Hills mansion returns at $35 million; reflects soaring value
stories.summary: A Beverly Hills mansion, once owned by actress Ann Rutherford, is back on the market for $35 million. The estate features extensive renovations and was originally built in 1938 by architect Paul R. Williams. This property, known for its Hollywood history, spans approximately 13,678 square feet with five bedrooms and luxurious amenities. It previously sold for $27.625 million after significant renovations expanded its size.

stories.title: Old Hollywood Estate Listed: Boris Karloff, Gregory Peck home relists; $6.5 million price
stories.summary: This iconic Beverly Hills estate, originally constructed for Boris Karloff in 1941, is now on the market for $6.5 million. The property boasts five spacious bedrooms, a separate guesthouse, and a kidney-shaped pool, all nestled within 4,585 square feet of Old Hollywood elegance and charm. Enjoy breathtaking views while owning a piece of cinematic history connected to Gregory Peck.

stories.title: Miami Beach’s 1936 Tides Hotel to reopen after nine years shut and a $95.6 million foreclosure battle
stories.summary: The historic Tides Hotel in Miami Beach, which has remained shuttered since Hurricane Irma in 2017, is set for a grand reopening in November 2026 after extensive renovations by its new owner, Safe Harbor Capital Partners. Legal disputes surrounding its financing and insurance have prolonged its closure. Newly acquired through a foreclosure auction, this iconic venue is ready to reclaim its status as a favorite among celebrities on Ocean Drive.

stories.title: Heirs Agree To Divide Ranch: Brite heirs settle 65,000-acre dispute; avert jury trial and sale
stories.summary: After years of contention, the heirs of the historic Brite Ranch have finally reached an agreement to split the vast 65,000-acre estate. This ranch, steeped in family history, has faced scrutiny from a court case launched in 2018 that revealed turmoil over trust management and financial allocation. Though lingering issues persist, this resolution is a significant step toward preserving the ranch and averting its sale.

stories.title: Oregon ranch with a self-sustaining lodge lists for $54 million
stories.summary: Ochoco Ranch, now listed at $54 million following a price reduction, offers an expansive 35,000 acres of lush Oregon timberland, ideal for recreational enthusiasts. The property features an impressive three-storey lodge promoting sustainable living alongside cozy smaller homes. As a functioning timber ranch, it generates revenue through timber sales and carbon offset initiatives, all connected by a robust network of roads for easy accessibility.

stories.title: 'Deeply concerning': India condemns attack on vessel carrying Indian crew off Oman coast
Hundreds of thousands of abandoned US mines now shelter bats and snakes after mining booms
stories.summary: The transformation of former mining sites into sanctuaries for bats and diverse wildlife plays a critical role in ecological conservation. Bat Conservation International works closely with various agencies to ensure these habitats flourish while prioritizing public safety. By installing specialized bat gates, they effectively control human access, allowing the ecosystems to thrive. Detailed surveys evaluate these sites' conditions, establishing a national inventory to support risk management and ecological restoration efforts.

stories.title: Jason Mraz transforms old San Diego avocado grove into a 17-acre regenerative organic farm
stories.summary: In 2004, Jason Mraz purchased an avocado grove near San Diego, which he transformed into Mraz Family Farms. Now known for its organic avocados, California-crafted coffee, and seasonal crops, the farm emphasizes regenerative agriculture for enhanced soil health and resilience. Products are supplied to local eateries and shops, and available online, adhering to seasonal availability. This journey showcases Mraz's dedication to sustainability and family-oriented farming.

stories.title: Border triangle airstrike: At least 13 gold miners killed in strike; toll could rise amid limited care
Owaisi urges 'Muslims voters' to build own leadership, takes aim at SP and Congress
stories.summary: In a passionate speech to voters in Azamgarh, Asaduddin Owaisi called on minority communities to pursue political autonomy and take charge of their own representation. He criticized the loyalty to long-established parties like Congress and SP, arguing they have failed to advocate for minority rights. Owaisi also examined the historical connections between Nehru and minority leaders, questioning whether current parties genuinely empower these groups.

stories.title: Another showdown in Delhi? INDIA bloc to hold protest over CEC; CJP gives 24-hour ultimatum
'Next PM Vijay 2029’: Placards trigger brief stir at PM Modi event in Chennai
stories.summary: During a government event in Chennai, PM Modi and CM Vijay inaugurated significant projects worth approximately Rs 13,000 crore. The gathering was briefly disrupted when supporters displayed placards promoting Vijay as the next Prime Minister. PM Modi emphasized the importance of cooperative federalism and vowed to continue supporting Tamil Nadu's development. Vijay called for the release of central funds and sought approval for additional infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Less-than-2-lane NH stretches shrink to 8% as high-speed corridors surge
stories.summary: India's national highway system has undergone remarkable enhancements, reducing two-lane stretches to only 8%. In the past nine years, high-speed corridors have expanded over twelve times. Officials note that newer expressways allow trucks to travel significantly faster than traditional highways. Plans include constructing about 51,000 kilometers of access-controlled corridors in the next ten years, aiming to boost transport efficiency and cut logistics expenses across the nation.

stories.title: Riyadh airport strike survivors: Houthi missile kills 12, injures 300; residents and travellers recount horror
‘City terrorised by rogue agency’: Mamdani seeks probe into ICE shooting of Dominican man in NYC
Jacksons Hill Sale Scrutiny: Victoria defends A$1m Nine deal; MP demands transparency
stories.summary: The sale of Jacksons Hill, a historic psychiatric hospital, to Channel Nine for A$1 million has sparked significant debate. Critics argue over the valuation and the absence of a competitive bidding process. With three heritage-listed buildings included, any redevelopment will demand meticulous restoration to comply with heritage regulations. The government's intent is to maintain the site's legacy while also promoting investment in the surrounding area.

stories.title: Tanker with 11 Indians on board attacked in Oman, 2 crew members missing
stories.summary: The tanker MT PETRO DOLPHIN faced an assault while anchored off the coast of Sohar, Oman, with 11 Indian crew aboard. While nine crew members were successfully rescued, two remain unaccounted for. Local Coast Guard authorities have mobilized search-and-rescue operations, with ongoing efforts to find the missing crew members. Minister Sarbananda Sonowal has pledged full support for the rescue efforts underway.

stories.title: CJI Surya Kant rejects INDIA bloc leaders’ request for meeting over ‘vote chori’
Florida protects 1,034-acre ranch once owned by governor in $6.52m conservation deal
stories.summary: Florida has approved a $6.52 million conservation easement to protect Limestone Creek Ranch from development. The 1,034-acre property has been involved in cattle ranching for over 70 years. This agreement allows continued agricultural operations while preventing future development on the land. Governor Ron DeSantis emphasized the importance of protecting Florida's unique lands and waters. The initiative is part of a broader effort involving over 10,770 acres across the state.

stories.title: Iranian protester hanged hours after marrying jailed fiancee over phone in prison ceremony
'Can't intimidate democracy': CPM MP John Brittas writes to CJI, President & RS chair over Delhi police 'assault'
stories.summary: During a media interaction, CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas detailed an incident where he was allegedly assaulted by the Delhi Police while protesting for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He has demanded an independent investigation into the matter, highlighting serious breaches of constitutional rights. This incident has triggered widespread protests in the national capital, leading to over 200 detentions as citizens rally against the Election Commission.

stories.title: ‘Our seas, our land’: Sri Lanka assures India against hostile acts from its territory
stories.summary: Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has stressed that his country will not allow its territory for hostile actions. He reiterated the commitment to a non-aligned foreign policy amid the US-Iran conflict and rejected military requests from both sides. Dissanayake emphasized humanitarian assistance will be provided if needed. Security cooperation with India was also reaffirmed during a recent meeting with Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh.

stories.title: Ukraine steps up attacks on Russian tech infrastructure, damages third data center
stories.summary: A recent drone strike by Ukraine has damaged a Yandex data center in Vladimir, disrupting operations and causing service outages in taxi and banking sectors across multiple cities. This incident is part of a series of continuous aerial assaults on Yandex facilities, raising alarms over rising diesel prices in the U.S. Additionally, a drone strike in Bryansk has resulted in casualties, intensifying regional tensions.

stories.title: Houthis claim Saudi airport attack that killed 12 as Middle East tensions rise
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen said Sunday's projectile hit Terminal 4 of the airport, causing a fire. Saudi air defences also intercepted a cruise missile near the airport, although authorities did not immediately provide further details about the latest incident. The airport remained closed following Saturday's attack.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says ready to hold Ukraine elections if Russia offers 60-day ceasefire
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky suggested organizing elections if a 60-day ceasefire with Russia is established. He reacted to criticisms from Donald Trump regarding his leadership and military actions. Zelensky emphasized that the decision of Ukraine's leadership lies with its people, not external figures. He acknowledged an announcement of an energy ceasefire, but stated it was news to him.

stories.title: Egypt’s ancient Fayoum portraits to be exhibited abroad for first time
stories.summary: Egypt recently revealed a restored version of the Tondo of the Two Brothers painting at a press conference. The painting, created during the second century, is part of the Fayoum portrait collection. Italian and Egyptian experts collaborated for three weeks on the restoration project in Tahrir. A major exhibition will showcase the restored portraits in Rome from November through May 2027.

stories.title: 'Don't teach us Tamil pride': DMK hits out at Rahul Gandhi over Hindi event title
Fuel tank cavities & Myanmar links: NCB busts 50 crores Yaba Haul, 2 Manipur residents arrested
stories.summary: The breakthrough comes as part of a wider, intensified crackdown on narcotics trafficking across the North Eastern region. Acting on intelligence inputs, NCB smeuths intercepted two suspicious trucks in Guwahati. A search of the vehicles uncovered specially fabricated concealed cavities cleverly built inside the fuel tanks -- a sophisticated method designed to evade law enforcement checkpoints. Officers recovered the massive consignment of methamphetamine on the spot. Both arrested suspects are residents of Bishnupur, Manipur.

stories.title: After Hindu Raksha Dal claims attack, saffron-clad groups threaten protesters again
George Foreman’s Texas estate with 40-car garage lists for $6 million
IndiGo Delhi-Chennai flight diverts to Hyderabad after electronic device battery catches fire
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai experienced a diversion to Hyderabad following a fire incident. The fire was caused by a battery in a passenger's personal electronic device, which emitted smoke. Crew members promptly extinguished the fire and ensured passenger safety during the diversion. An alternate aircraft was arranged to continue the journey to Chennai after the incident.

stories.title: Rare Ming dynasty pomegranate box bought for £19 in 1946 sells for £288,000 after attic discovery
stories.summary: A 15th-century Chinese enamel box, originally bought for £19, sold for £288,000 at an auction. The box was rediscovered in a family attic where it remained unnoticed for decades. Major Edward Copleston Radcliffe acquired the box in 1946, and it was assessed by Dreweatts auction house. Experts confirmed the box's significance, linking it to the rare Xuande-marked pomegranate boxes.

stories.title: ‘This is your time’: PM Modi tells Chennai students to think big, take Tamil culture to the world
Houthis blame Saudi Arabia for another strike on Sanaa's airport
stories.summary: Air strikes were reported by Houthi-aligned media on Houthi-held territories including Sanaa international airport. The Saudi-led coalition condemned an earlier attack that caused civilian casualties and incurred fatalities from different nationalities. Houthi spokesperson warned against the use of Saudi airspace by airlines, asserting their military strategy. The conflict between the two sides has escalated, leading to significant civilian impacts and suffering.

stories.title: ‘People want change’: Sachin Pilot says Congress will return to power in Punjab with absolute majority
stories.summary: Sachin Pilot expressed confidence in Congress regaining power in Punjab with an absolute majority in upcoming elections. He emphasized the loss of public faith in the Aam Aadmi Party government and the desire for change. Newly appointed Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh called for collective action to address the state's challenges. Former chief minister Charanjit Singh Channi highlighted issues such as corruption and drug abuse under the AAP administration.

stories.title: 'Good for Americans': US treasury secretary defends Russia diesel deal, cites 'legal authority'
stories.summary: Defending the diesel supply agreement with Russia, Scott Bessent highlights the Trump administration's strategy to alleviate fuel prices. The deal initiates with more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel heading from Russia, with an additional 3 million tonnes expected shortly. The US Treasury Secretary assures that the decision rests on legal foundations, with promising implications for both American consumers and the international trading landscape.

stories.title: 'Not the India we want': Rahul Gandhi lashes out at PM Modi, Amit Shah over Delhi protest crackdown
CJP protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar blocked in Goa, dozens detained
stories.summary: On Sunday, several protesters were detained by Goa Police during a demonstration targeting chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Noteworthy individuals, including Ferdin Rebello, the former chief justice of Allahabad high court, were not allowed to enter the protest area. Instead, demonstrators gathered outside the Goa Police headquarters, demanding Gyanesh Kumar's resignation due to alleged electoral roll irregularities, raising alarms about citizens' rights to peaceful assembly.

stories.title: Florida family’s 498-acre cattle ranch protected from development through $7.48m conservation easement
stories.summary: A 498-acre cattle ranch known as Turnpike Dairy has been protected from future development through a conservation easement. The agreement allows the managing family to continue agricultural operations on the property. Martin County contributed $3.74 million towards the $7.48 million deal to preserve the land. This conservation effort is part of Florida’s Rural and Family Lands Protection Program, which protects working farms.

stories.title: 'Cops wanted to torment my parents at 3.30 am': Dipke's rebuttal to Delhi Police's clip
stories.summary: In a statement reacting to the police's account, Dipke said he had repeatedly requested access to his phone to retrieve his cousin's number and speak to a lawyer, but was denied both requests. He also questioned why officers asked him to call his father at 3.30 am and tell him that he could be sent to jail for a long time.

stories.title: Florida school district approves third bid for $15.13M riverfront HQ sale
US air museum to reopen as storm-damaged World War II hangar finds new owner for $1
stories.summary: An 83-year-old World War II-era blimp hangar in Oregon, US, was sold for just $1 after a storm tore a 200-foot hole in its roof in December 2025. The historic building, which houses the Tillamook Air Museum, was purchased by a nonprofit organisation and is set to reopen on October 29 after nearly 10 months of closure.

stories.title: Abhishek Banerjee faces fresh questioning in billboard row as police visit home again
Evening news wrap: Police release Dipke's detention video; PM Modi pledges support to Tamil Nadu & more
stories.summary: Delhi Police released a video showing Abhijeet Dipke being informed of his grandmother's passing during detention. Prime Minister Modi pledged ongoing support for Tamil Nadu's infrastructure projects worth Rs 13,000 crore. An IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai made an emergency landing in Hyderabad after smoke was detected from a passenger's power bank. A scuffle erupted at the UP Congress office ahead of Aradhana Mishra's takeover as state president.

stories.title: Federal judge halts ICE detention centre construction at California site over environmental review
stories.summary: A federal judge has granted a preliminary injunction halting construction of an ICE facility near Gilroy, California. The ruling came in response to a lawsuit filed by California Attorney General Rob Bonta and Santa Clara County. They argued that construction began without an adequate environmental assessment or consultations with local officials. Environmental risks associated with the site, such as septic system capacity and hazardous materials, were also raised.

stories.title: Delhi cops release video when they told Dipke in detention of grandmother’s death - watch
stories.summary: Delhi Police released a video showing officers informing Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke about his grandmother’s death in detention and offering help with travel arrangements for her last rites, which he declined. The release followed his mother’s allegation that police had failed to inform him. Dipke was detained ahead of a proposed protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation and later released on an undertaking to maintain public order.

stories.title: 9-million-year-old capybara tooth reveals wetter past of Atacama Desert
‘Competition of anarchy’: BJP hits out at Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal amid CEC protest row
stories.summary: BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj condemned Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and Aam Aadmi Party leader Arvind Kejriwal for losing their voter base. She accused both parties of seeking excuses for their electoral defeats instead of constructive politics. Rahul Gandhi announced upcoming protests to challenge the government's actions against demonstrators. Kejriwal criticized PM Modi for police actions during protests and invoked historical comparisons.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery ahead of major South America trip in November
stories.summary: Addressing the public during his traditional Sunday noon blessing, Leo thanked those who had expressed concern and asked them to keep him in their prayers. The pope said the abnormality had been detected at an early stage and was localised, adding that he had decided to proceed with surgery on medical advice.

stories.title: Colorado woman protects 18,484 acres of family ranch once listed for $100 million
stories.summary: A Colorado woman has permanently protected 18,484 acres of her family's cattle ranch, once listed for $100 million, from future development. Susan Nottingham's decision preserves land her parents spent over 60 years assembling, along with historic water rights linked to the Colorado River. The agreement also protects wildlife habitats while allowing the ranch to continue agricultural operations.

stories.title: 48 lakh calls in four years: India turns to Tele-MANAS as WHO flags mental healthcare gaps
stories.summary: Since its launch in October 2022, Tele-MANAS has received almost 48 lakh calls, highlighting a crucial demand for accessible mental health support. As the World Health Organization underscores the importance of community-focused care over hospital-based treatment, it is revealed that many countries still rely heavily on psychiatric facilities. In India, a noteworthy portion of the callers are aged between 18 and 45 years.

stories.title: ‘No place to breathe’: AISA’s Neha Bora detained again, alleges police brutality
'Your confidence is most vital': Supreme Court to Kapil Sibal after his 'no faith' remark
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Sunday directed authorities to prevent illegal detention of people participating in peaceful gatherings amid the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests in Delhi. It also asked the Centre to ensure that metro services operate normally and internet access remains uninterrupted, subject to law and order requirements. Sibal welcomed the court's order in connection with the restrictions imposed in Delhi amid protests, saying it restores faith in the country's justice system.

stories.title: Tattoo ink vanishes in sunlight, stays switchable in skin for up to 2.2 years
'Security agencies face challenge from Starlink:' Nishikant Dubey
Congress thanks CM Vijay for acknowledging the allies role in TVK's bypolls victory
stories.summary: TVK, Congress, the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) and Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) are among the constituents of the SSV alliance. The results brought renewed attention to the role of TVK's alliance partners in the ruling party's electoral performance. Congress, VCK, IUML and other allies campaigned alongside TVK candidates, with alliance leaders appearing together during the bypoll campaign.

stories.title: NIA arrests another accused in JMB-linked terror conspiracy
stories.summary: On Saturday, the National Investigation Agency (NIA) apprehended another suspect from West Bengal in relation to a terror conspiracy. This individual allegedly collaborated with the Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh's branch, Imam Mahmuder Kafila, to enhance their presence in India. Using covert meetings and digital channels, they promoted radicalization and disseminated anti-India propaganda.

stories.title: Australian developer sues for A$100 million after rail project stalls 218-apartment construction
stories.summary: An Australian property developer has sued Victoria's Suburban Rail Loop Authority for at least A$100 million after a railway project stalled construction of 218 apartments in Melbourne for two years. The dispute concerns the government's acquisition of underground land, leaving more than 100 homebuyers waiting for their apartments.

stories.title: Houthis exempt Mecca, Medina airports from attacks as Riyadh vows revenge
stories.summary: On Sunday, the Houthis issued a warning against using Saudi airspace for all but Mecca and Medina airports. This warning follows an attack on Riyadh's international airport that resulted in civilian casualties and fatalities. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree indicated their targeting actions would continue based on a tit-for-tat strategy. Saudi Arabia vowed retaliation, labeling the attack a war crime and a violation of international law.

stories.title: Poland holds emergency meeting over possible attack on PM Tusk, defence minister
stories.summary: Polish security services convened an emergency meeting following a reported threat against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz. Authorities have been on high alert due to recent violent incidents at schools in Poland. These incidents led to arrests and concerns about online glorification of violence among youth. Tusk emphasized the spontaneous nature of these acts, suggesting no organized group is involved.

stories.title: In 1958, voters rejected a $15 million reservoir; 68 years later, judge overturns Lake Ringgold permit
stories.summary: A recent ruling by a Texas judge has nullified the permit for Wichita Falls' proposed Lake Ringgold reservoir project, which sought to address acute water shortages caused by ongoing drought. This controversial plan raised red flags among ranchers and conservation advocates, as it would affect approximately 16,000 acres of land, threatening to uproot numerous ranching families. The city is now contemplating an appeal and strategizing alternative water solutions.

stories.title: New Zealand man sells home with 370m miniature railway after 11 years of work
Three Indians rescued from attacked cargo ship in Black sea depart for India
stories.summary: Amidst a distressing attack on the Turkish-owned MV Royad Mammadov cargo vessel in the Black Sea, three Indian nationals were successfully rescued. After receiving medical care in Romania, they were declared stable. The Indian embassy played a crucial role in ensuring their safe return and provided necessary supplies during their ordeal. Unfortunately, the attack also led to the loss of two foreign seafarers' lives, underscoring the gravity of maritime risks.

stories.title: Nepal floods: Chilling videos show bridges swept away, homes destroyed
stories.summary: A sudden flash flood in Gorkha district along the Budhi Gandaki River has wreaked havoc, causing severe destruction and displacing many families. With reports of multiple homes and bridges lost, at least ten individuals are currently unaccounted for. In light of the crisis, authorities have deployed rescue teams and helicopters to aid in evacuations.

stories.title: A Vietnam War veteran turned discarded materials into Colorado's famous Cano's Castle
stories.summary: Cano's Castle, a roadside attraction in Antonito, Colorado, was built by Vietnam War veteran Dominic “Cano” Espinoza using discarded beer cans, hubcaps, screen doors and scrap metal. Construction reportedly began in 1980. More than four decades later, a fire in January 2022 destroyed the residential section of the property, although its two main towers survived.

stories.title: ‘It's now or never’: India Youth Congress calls for mass mobilisation in Delhi on October 12 over ‘vote chori’ allegations
stories.summary: Indian Youth Congress has announced a protest on October 12 to defend democracy and the Constitution. The campaign is in response to allegations of electoral irregularities against the Election Commission. Rahul Gandhi and other leaders have been involved in protests against these electoral issues. Additionally, the Congress delegation raised concerns to President Droupadi Murmu regarding the electoral process.

stories.title: ‘Detain, arrest, we won't be intimidated’: CJP's team held again, vows to continue Delhi protest
'Modi ji himself may have to resign': Kejriwal's Hitler jibe over Delhi protest crackdown
UC San Diego finds genetic switch that gave butterflies richer colour vision
This couple's $100 million gift made Yale School of Music tuition-free
stories.summary: A $100 million donation by Stephen and Denise Adams in 2005 made Yale School of Music tuition-free for admitted students. More than 20 years later, the school continues to offer full-tuition awards and fellowships. The couple, who initially donated anonymously, also supported improvements to the school's academic programmes and music facilities.

stories.title: T’Emi Oshin: Wayne State’s first Obama-Chesky voyager scholar
70-year-old woman swims 20 miles across Catalina Channel to support kidney charity
In 1967, an Australian man built a house from discarded glass bottles; today, it is a mining museum
stories.summary: Built in 1967 by Tex Moeckel, the Bottle House in Lightning Ridge is constructed from discarded glass bottles. The structure has become a tourist attraction and a museum showcasing local opal-mining history and vintage bottles. Initially serving as part of a miner's camp, it reflects the area's long mining heritage. Visitors can explore various artefacts linked to opal mining and local history within the museum.

stories.title: Nasa-backed spacecraft to inspect dead space objects, test future repair and debris removal tech
stories.summary: NASA has launched a washing-machine-sized spacecraft to inspect up to four inactive satellites and rocket bodies in low Earth orbit. The SSPICY mission, launched on October 1, will begin inspections in early 2027. Using autonomous navigation, sensors and electric propulsion, the spacecraft will test technologies that could eventually help repair satellites or remove orbital debris.

stories.title: 'No illegal detentions, restore internet, metro services': Supreme Court after Delhi protest crackdown - top quotes
'Will talk about undeclared Emergency': Kharge says Congress to meet CJI over ‘vote chori’ allegations
stories.summary: In a significant move, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has announced plans for a meeting with the Chief Justice of India. He, alongside senior leader Rahul Gandhi, intends to discuss pressing issues regarding the independence of constitutional institutions. Kharge raised concerns about the Election Commission's functioning and criticized new legislation that he believes contributes to electoral malpractice, terming the current political landscape an undeclared Emergency orchestrated by the government.

stories.title: 'Starlink poses risk to security agencies': BJP MP Nishikant Dubey responds to Musk's charge
Dutch Circular Cycle Bridge: Eindhoven lifts bikes above traffic
‘We cannot let this become normal’: AISA's Neha Bora on Delhi protest crackdown
Wild horses and donkeys dig desert wells in Arizona, supplying water to 57 vertebrate species
stories.summary: Researchers studied wild horses and donkeys in the Sonoran Desert, which dig wells that attract diverse wildlife. The wells serve as critical water sources for various vertebrate species during dry periods. Observations indicated that these wells significantly increase water accessibility and create favorable conditions for cottonwood seedlings. The study highlights the animals' role as ecosystem engineers in changing their environment.

stories.title: Washington Supreme Court irrigation case: Farmer contests $618,000 irrigation penalties
stories.summary: Ron Fodé, a dedicated farmer from Washington State, is fighting against hefty penalties threatening his agricultural livelihood due to irrigation practices. The conflict arose in 2017 over water rights for his crops, leading to the Department of Ecology rejecting his irrigation assistance applications. This has resulted in penalties totaling $618,000.

stories.title: 'Sikh sentiments hurt': Gurdwara body questions protesters, police for intrusion into premises
'No breach of peace for one year': Delhi court's condition for release of Dipke, Das, Ranka
A 100-kg green anaconda can disappear beneath Amazonian vegetation
stories.summary: Green Anacondas in Peru's Amazon rainforest were challenging to locate due to their hidden behavior. Researchers recorded observations across various habitats, mostly in floodplain forests. The snakes were often concealed among logs, submerged vegetation, and other natural cover. Basking conditions were primarily found in rivers and vegetation mats of oxbow lakes. The findings highlight the difficulty in assessing the presence and population trends of these snakes.

stories.title: 'Interference in internal affairs': India rebukes UN human rights body over Delhi protest crackdown
Family mistook missing Rodin sculpture for a copy; 1892 original sold for $1 million
‘Partisan role’: RJD leader moves SC over Delhi Police action, alleges sexual harassment of women protesters
‘Grandmother's rites on hold': Abhijeet Dipke's mother claims Delhi Police is lying over giving him the news
Christie Brinkley turned her 20-acre Hamptons estate into a private castle
India condemns 'dastardly' attacks on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport that killed 12
Diane Warren gives famous Hollywood pig Wilbur a seven-acre sanctuary
'Every Indian is angry': CJP's Ajinkya Shinde announces protests across country, starting with Mumbai's Shivaji Park at 4pm today
WA Bravery Awards honour Perth father who saved his daughter from drowning
'Ambani won't go out of business': Elon Musk says Starlink competition would benefit Indians
Hurricane Isaias kills 4 in US, leaves hundreds of thousands without power - video
Baltimore used crushed glass on 17 streets to create a sparkling effect
stories.summary: Baltimore's streets are shining bright with the introduction of recycled glass in 17 new pavement projects. This unique initiative employs crushed glass to replace standard aggregates in asphalt, showcasing an eye-catching finish. Trials reveal that mixes of 10 to 15% glass meet performance expectations, bolstered by Federal Highway Administration backing. For broader implementation, maintaining quality specifications and a steady glass supply is crucial.

stories.title: 'BJP's honouring women': Akhilesh shares video of harassment during Delhi crackdown
‘Blatant attack on press freedom’: Journalists’ bodies condemn detention of journalists at Delhi protest
In 1929, J. M. Barrie gifted Peter Pan rights to a hospital; UK law protects its royalties
stories.summary: In 1929, J. M. Barrie selflessly granted the rights to Peter Pan, establishing a perpetual source of funding for Great Ormond Street Hospital. The hospital benefits from the story's performances, facilitating care for critically ill children. A unique UK law safeguards this donation, ensuring royalties persist beyond copyright expiry. Barrie's ties to the hospital remain influential, demonstrating the power of literature in sustaining charitable endeavors.

stories.title: James Patterson raised his 2015 school library donation to $1.75m, helping 467 US libraries
stories.summary: James Patterson initially pledged $1.25 million to support US school libraries but increased the donation to $1.75 million. This increase followed an overwhelming response from schools, revealing their pressing needs for resources. A total of 467 libraries benefited from the grants, funding books, technology, and repairs. The American Association of School Librarians recognized Patterson for his advocacy and financial contributions.

stories.title: Scottish trawler hit rocks after exhausted skipper fell asleep, with no watch alarm fitted
Personality rights: HC asks Amitabh Bachchan to appear if settlement fails
CJP leaders' detention: Here’s all that happened on board AI 2428
Australia planted rubber vine in the 1860s; it now covers vast Queensland areas
Parliament, not streets, will govern country: BJP; govt is rattled, says oppn
Restrained, detained, contained: Clampdown foils stir, thousands confined to home, nabbed on way
New Zealand’s 1904 bridge survived replacement and became a historic landmark
Jackie Chan’s dollar-by-dollar school campaign raises over $192,000 for rural Chinese children
stories.summary: Jackie Chan transformed the act of giving into a global movement, urging fans to pitch in small donations for constructing schools in rural China. After six years, the initiative garnered over $96,000, which Chan generously matched, resulting in a remarkable total of over $192,000. This remarkable effort not only facilitated multiple school buildings but also underscored the power of collective action in uplifting communities through education.

stories.title: SIR stir: 'Kashmir model' in Delhi, situation akin to Emergency, says opposition
Anxiety treatable, but 83% of affected did not get help
Understand, don't just hear out a child in conflict with law: CJI
'Tata bye-bye': 2-term BJP MP quits party over Rajya Sabha ticket snub
Manipur MP calls his dismissal as JNU prof 'witch hunt'
NIA files FIR to probe flydubai incident
Curbs fail to mute anti-SIR chorus sweeping states
BJP slams Rahul Gandhi for claiming Murmu accepted 'vote chori'
CJP protest: How government pre-empted 'plot to incite violence'
Harvard’s $27.50 stained document was a rare Magna Carta original
Taylor Swift’s $4M Nashville education centre showcases art by schoolchildren and artists with disabilities
stories.summary: In 2012, Taylor Swift donated $4 million to create an education center at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. This center focuses on engaging children and families with the history of country music. Currently, it hosts an exhibition called Connection featuring works by students and artists from Friends Life Community. Participants learn letterpress printing techniques and create their own unique posters.

stories.title: State Seeks Missing Donations: New York AG sues teen’s relatives; raises oversight questions
stories.summary: Hailey Bodah, a young New Yorker, faced unimaginable loss when a fire claimed the lives of her father and four sisters. In the wake of this tragedy, generous relatives raised over $100,000 to help her. However, legal issues emerged regarding the management of the funds, with the New York Attorney General’s office demanding the return of over $71,000.

stories.title: Steve McQueen’s former Malibu home sold for $7.2m in 2020; later renovated and listed for $16.995m
stories.summary: Steve McQueen's iconic Malibu beach house passed through several ownership hands before receiving significant renovations from its latest buyers. Boasting oceanfront decks and private beach access, this esteemed property is nestled within an exclusive gated community. Initially bought for $8.35 million, it was revamped and relisted at $16.995 million, eventually selling for $13.6 million in September 2023, with its connection to McQueen and MacGraw continuing to garner interest.

stories.title: Delimitation a design to punish TN reduce its voice in Parliament: Rahul Gandhi
'As one of the largest research universities...': Arizona State responds to federal probe into J-1 visa use after JD Vance says 'something weird is going on'
Rahul Gandhi: 'My message to students: you have nothing to fear. We are standing with you'
Strong pushback as US downgrades Hong Kong to tier-3 in human trafficking: 'Double standard'
Teacher married a surgeon in 1969 and turned their farm into a nature preserve
Couple Turn Ride Into Fundraiser: Utah pair cycle 3,634 miles in 87 days; raise about $23,000
stories.summary: A couple from Utah marked their 40th wedding anniversary with an epic cycling adventure across the United States, covering more than 3,600 miles in 87 days. Their mission was to raise awareness and funds for affordable housing and food assistance. Along the way, they navigated diverse terrains and overcame significant obstacles, bringing attention to the plight of families grappling with housing and food insecurity.

stories.title: Why a $125 million Lake Tahoe ranch remains unsold
stories.summary: Shakespeare Ranch, a historic estate in Lake Tahoe, has struggled to find a buyer since listing. The property was initially priced at $188 million but has seen a price reduction to $125 million. Potential buyers are now interested in purchasing parts of the estate instead of the entire property. The main house, called Water’s Edge, is for sale at $39.5 million and features extensive amenities.

stories.title: Police recover arms, ammunition from north Kashmir forests
Ufo-Style Futuro Home Listed: Rare space-age house hits market; $1.495m price reflects preservation
stories.summary: Nestled in California's stunning landscape, the Donaldson Futuro is a captivating flying saucer-shaped home now listed for $1.495 million. Constructed in 1969, this architectural marvel exemplifies space-age design and carries historical weight. After languishing in neglect, it was expertly restored by Milford Wayne Donaldson, preserving its mid-century essence while integrating modern comforts. This is a unique opportunity to embrace a landmark of architectural history.

stories.title: Florida cyber owner accused of misleading ransomware victims; firm charged $19M, secretly paid hackers $8M
stories.summary: Zohar Pinhasi, the owner of MonsterCloud, faces charges of wire fraud related to his cybersecurity business. Prosecutors allege he misrepresented his firm's capabilities to clients facing ransomware attacks. Instead of recovering data without ransom payment, he secretly paid attackers and charged clients significantly higher fees. Pinhasi allegedly collected over $19 million while paying more than $8 million in ransoms.

stories.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike back in prison from hospital after failed execution
stories.summary: Christa Pike, a Tennessee death row inmate, has returned to prison after a failed execution attempt. The September 30 incident resulted in her needing medical care after the lethal injection process failed. Governor Bill Lee has ordered a review of the state's execution procedures following this incident. Pike had been sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of her classmate, Colleen Slemmer.

stories.title: 'Misplaced, unwarranted': India slams OHCHR for raising concern over SIR protest
‘Thanks for teaching youngsters’: Tharoor takes dig at PM Modi, shares 2015 tweet
Amid claims that Kimberly Guilfoyle charged money to give access to Trump, leaked texts reveal her breakup with Donald Trump Jr was nasty
Craig Tiley loses $5.75 million on beachfront home sale
stories.summary: Craig Tiley's beachfront home in Aspendale was sold at a loss after he purchased it for $13.1 million. He listed the property for $11.5 million before reducing the price to $8.75 million. The final sale price of $7.35 million amounted to a financial loss of $5.75 million. Tiley also incurred an additional cost of $831,500 in stamp duty related to the sale.

stories.title: Jane Fonda’s former home, once surveilled by the CIA, lists for $1.99M
stories.summary: Jane Fonda's iconic Hollywood Hills home, rooted in history and activism, is up for grabs at $1.99 million. This stunning Mediterranean Revival villa, built in 1932, reflects not only Fonda's journey but also the era's spirit. With five bedrooms and numerous amenities, it has been in the hands of Kathleen Whyte since 1985. Initially launched at $2.79 million in 2024, the price has now seen a significant cut.

stories.title: Delhi protests: Mamata, Kejriwal and 7,000 protesters released; CJP leaders still in detention
Telangana CM directs officials to prepare El Nino action plan
stories.summary: Telangana's chief minister A Revanth Reddy convened an urgent meeting to tackle the repercussions of El Nino, focusing on essential needs in agriculture, water, and electricity. The region has faced a 17 percent deficit in monsoon rainfall, leading to drought conditions. Reddy underscored the need for community engagement in responsible energy use and awareness, announcing a follow-up session with ministers to explore agricultural strategies in light of these challenges.

stories.title: Saudi airport attacked again: Missile strikes passenger terminal, many injured
165-million-year-old fossil from China reveals mammal ancestor that swam and swallowed like mammals
stories.summary: Scientists have identified a 165-million-year-old mammal predecessor from China that had a broad tail for swimming and throat bones similar to those of modern mammals. Named Megacauda sungei, the Jurassic-era animal could chew and swallow food using specialised structures. Published in Nature, the findings offer new insights into how early mammals developed different feeding abilities.

stories.title: Stage set for Sunday showdown: CJP to march again tomorrow; traffic advisory issued
Inside Luke Bryan’s 150-acre Tennessee farm with a rescue barn
stories.summary: Luke Bryan and his wife, Caroline Boyer, purchased a 150-acre farm in Williamson County, Tennessee, in 2012. They transformed it into Red Bird Farm, featuring a 10,000-square-foot main house, a guesthouse, and a party barn. The couple built a bass lake, which was a significant part of Bryan's childhood dream. Their farm also functions as a rescue space for animals under the Brett Boyer Foundation.

stories.title: Indian-origin US Army veteran made cousin do household chores, confiscated immigration papers, punished through physical abuse, sleep deprivation
Queens’ historic Lost Battalion Hall reopens after $25.9m reconstruction
stories.summary: Queens’ historic Lost Battalion Hall has reopened after a $25.9 million reconstruction. The 87-year-old recreation center now has upgraded fitness rooms, accessible facilities, modern safety systems and a refreshed basketball court.

stories.title: Suvendu eyes Bengal sweep: Can Mamata, Congress unite to challenge BJP?
Dr Phil lists Beverly Hills estate for $67.5m after buying it for $29.8m
stories.summary: Dr. Phil McGraw and his wife Robin have put their luxurious Beverly Hills estate on the market for an impressive $67.5 million. After acquiring it for $29.8 million in 2010 and taking another seven years to complete its construction by 2011, the sprawling 16,079 square foot residence is accompanied by guest and staff quarters. Among its exquisite features are a swimming pool, wine cellar, and tennis court.

stories.title: Listed at $8M, this 112-year-old home sells for $15M
stories.summary: At 2 Sixth Avenue in San Francisco, a remarkable house came onto the market with an asking price of $7.999 million but ultimately sold for a staggering $15 million. Having belonged to one family for seven decades, the well-appointed home includes four bedrooms and three bathrooms across 4,490 square feet.

stories.title: 'Fight should be face-to-face': CM Yogi accepts Akhilesh's Ayodhya challenge
Delhi protests: SC to hear plea seeking contempt action against authorities on Sunday
‘Another Jantar Mantar’: AAP workers gherao police station after Kejriwal’s detention
'Tired of going to courts, have no hope': Ex-Union minister Kapil Sibal on Delhi curbs for CJP stir
In 2024, 23-year-old woman died during wisdom tooth removal in Canada. Two years later, her father sues dentist, seeks funeral expenses
Wisconsin protects over 1,700 Lake Superior acres, restores wetlands and habitat
stories.summary: Wisconsin's Lake Superior shoreline has witnessed a transformative conservation effort, safeguarding over 1,700 acres through collaboration between the US Fish and Wildlife Service and Landmark Conservancy. By utilizing conservation easements, the project enabled landowners to retain property rights while preserving vital habitats. Key activities included the planting of conifers and the management of invasive species, fulfilling the environmental aspirations of the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative.

stories.title: Third school attack in Poland in a week sparks safety concerns
stories.summary: Three school attacks recently occurred in Poland, resulting in injuries to multiple individuals. The first attack involved a 19-year-old student injuring nine people at a vocational school. A second incident by a 15-year-old resulted in the death of a custodian and injuries to others. Authorities responded by tightening security measures across various schools and detaining several individuals for potential threats.

stories.title: Entire Delhi shut down; police, BJP's 'goondas' beat up students: Rahul Gandhi at Chhatron Ki Goonj
Scotty’s Castle reopens for limited tours 11 years after Death Valley flash flood forced its closure
stories.summary: More than a decade after a flash flood forced Scotty’s Castle to close, Death Valley National Park is bringing visitors back for limited exterior tours from October 10 as a $71 million restoration effort continues.

stories.title: ‘Is peacefully raising your voice a crime?’ CJP alleges Delhi Police dragged, forcibly detained protesters
This California mansion has a train, tunnel and station
stories.summary: A luxurious estate in La Cañada Flintridge was recently sold for $8.5 million, attracting numerous potential buyers. The property includes a custom five-passenger garden railway that enhances its unique appeal and charm. Additionally, the house consists of six bedrooms, eight bathrooms, and a gourmet kitchen perfect for entertaining. Extensive outdoor features include a swimming pool, vegetable garden, and manicured landscapes recognized with multiple awards.

stories.title: Restoration Ecology Study Findings: Tidal flows fuel Marsh Wren surge; broader marsh birds gain
stories.summary: California's initiative to revive the Dutch Slough wetlands has led to a stunning resurgence of Marsh Wren numbers. Recent bird surveys from 2020 to 2025 indicate significant increases in the density of various marsh-dwelling species. This restoration process involved planting indigenous plants and reinstating tidal flows to previous agricultural terrains. While some species saw a decline, overall avian diversity thrived in these rejuvenated areas.

stories.title: From mass detentions to political war of words: How Delhi protests unfolded
Texas-bound American Airlines flight diverted to New York's JFK after six out of eight lavatories stopped working: 'Only two potties?'
‘Loud slogans, selective action’: BJP chief Nabin questions Rahul’s silence on allegations against Congress MP after JNU dismissal
'Seek to turn Delhi into battleground': CM Rekha Gupta slams CJP, Rahul & Kejriwal amid anti-SIR protests
stories.summary: Delhi's Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has placed the spotlight on Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal, blaming them for worsening political strife in the capital. Amid protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, thousands faced detainment while trying to reach Jantar Mantar. Gupta expressed concern over the opposition's actions impacting public life, stating they undermine the democratic mandate.

stories.title: The period cycle: What happens in your body beyond the five days of bleeding
stories.summary: When we discuss menstrual health, it’s important to recognize that it’s more than just the time of the month. Hormonal changes are ongoing and can impact women's overall well-being, including energy, emotions, and comfort levels. Understanding these aspects leads to dismantling harmful taboos and encourages supportive behaviors in both personal and professional environments, promoting a healthier dialogue around menstruation.

stories.title: Pregnant woman & 2 children among 9 killed in Pennsylvania shooting; gunman dies by suicide
Evening news wrap: Delhi in grips of anti-CEC stir; oppn leaders & protesters detained, BJP targets Congress
In 1969, a Nevada man built a desert home from junk; today, Thunder Mountain is a free attraction
stories.summary: Thunder Mountain Monument in Nevada features sculptures created from discarded materials by Frank Van Zant. This unique roadside attraction developed from his personal vision to honor Native American history. After a fire in 1983, the site faced preservation challenges until it was recognized as a historic site in 1992. The monument is maintained today with visitor donations and a caretaker's assistance.

stories.title: David Gilmour sold his guitars for $21.5 million to fund climate change and nature protection work
stories.summary: In June 2019, David Gilmour sold over 120 guitars, significantly benefitting ClientEarth with the proceeds. Among them was the iconic 1969 Fender Stratocaster, which achieved a record sale price. These funds were dedicated to advancing environmental law initiatives aimed at combatting climate change. This remarkable auction intertwined rock legacy and ecological activism, illustrating Gilmour's commitment to fostering a sustainable future through music.

stories.title: Stones hurled at bus carrying detained protesters in Delhi’s Jhandewalan, cops injured
‘Their core characteristic is cowardice’: Rahul Gandhi targets PM Modi, RSS; backs youth protesting against CEC
‘Rigged when you lose?’ 124 former bureaucrats defend EC & SIR, challenge vote-rigging claims
Calcutta high court says peaceful protest not an offence just because authorities dislike it
Delhi protests: Over 7,000 detained as CJP stir against CEC triggers political face-off - top developments
stories.summary: Delhi Police detained upwards of 3,000 demonstrators on Saturday, protesting against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter-list manipulation, insisting on his resignation. Prominent political figures such as Arvind Kejriwal and Mamata Banerjee were among those arrested. Opposition members criticized the government for suppressing free speech by halting protests and imposing internet shutdowns, while the BJP defended their stance, calling the demonstrations a ploy to incite chaos.

stories.title: ‘Will be compelled to consider fast or march’: Wangchuk seeks release of detainees
‘Country governed by Parliament, not streets’: BJP slams oppn, CJP over protests
Kamala Harris faces pushback over 2028 presidential bid as husband, Democratic donors express doubts
Akie Abe,wife of late Japanese PM Shinzo Abe, meets RSS leader Hosabale
Rihanna’s foundation teamed up with bicycle company to help girls in Malawi get to school
stories.summary: In an inspiring collaboration, Rihanna's Clara Lionel Foundation has teamed up with Ofo to enhance educational access for girls in Malawi through the 1 KM Action initiative. This initiative not only provides bicycles but also offers scholarships, alleviating the burdens of travel and educational expenses. Following the partnership announcement, the first bicycles arrived, significantly facilitating school attendance.

Zak Bagans buys $4.55M underground Las Vegas bunker for public museum

INDIA bloc top leaders to meet President today evening over functioning of EC under CEC Gyanesh Kumar, MPs to gather at Central Hall ahead of meeting
stories.summary: The INDIA bloc, a coalition of opposition parties, is gearing up for a significant meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. This meeting is pivotal as it aims to address issues related to the Election Commission's operations. Key leaders from various parties will assemble in Parliament before proceeding to the President's office.

stories.title: ‘These are young students’: SC rejects plea seeking free hand for Delhi Police to deal with protesters
12-year-old girl gives father £500 to build mushroom-shaped house; it wins Shed of the Year 2017
stories.summary: A 12-year-old girl in Surrey gave her father £500 from her savings to build a mushroom-shaped house in their garden. Ben Swanborough created a two-storey hideaway featuring a trapdoor, stained-glass windows, a glass floor overlooking a stream and a glass roof for stargazing. The unusual structure went on to win the 2017 Shed of the Year competition.

stories.title: Makeup, colourful scarves: Bizarre reasons Taliban uses to detain women
Shannen Doherty’s Malibu sanctuary sells for $7.65M after $9.5M posthumous listing
stories.summary: Shannen Doherty's stunning Malibu home, originally priced at $9.5 million, has now sold for $7.65 million after several price adjustments. This five-bedroom residence was a refuge for Doherty during her courageous fight against cancer. Following the severe damage from the Woolsey Fire in 2018, significant renovations restored its charm and elevated its desirability.

stories.title: Sydney Sweeney’s $6.2 million Bel-Air estate preserves old Hollywood charm
Miami airport passenger had ‘unexplained bulge’; 10 live birds found in underwear
